title: Hamlet, revenge!
html_source: The ghost had implored Hamlet: “If thou didst ever thy dear father love…” Hamlet: “O God!” Ghost: “Revenge his foul and most unnatural murder.” This can be taken as a charge to Stephen to avenge the foul spiritual murder of Ireland. Irish culture now but consumes its youth by its corruption and paralysis.
